words.sense: To restore a supply by adding more after some has been used up.
misconceptions: Treating any new purchase as restocking.

words.sense: To remove or substitute one object, part, or person with another.
misconceptions: Treating refilling a supply as swapping out the container.

semantic_axes.description: Replenish restores a depleted supply; replace substitutes a different item for an existing item.

edges.boundary_rule: Replenish restores a depleted supply; replace substitutes a different item for an existing item.
clues_a: tops up what is running low
adds units back into a container
irrelevant_clues: the brand or colour of new stock
whether the replacement comes in a box

misconceptions.M1: Treating any new purchase as restocking.
misconceptions.M2: Treating refilling a supply as swapping out the container.
misconceptions.M3: Ignoring whether an individual item was removed.
